turns.user: Can we buy the 5-litre gaskets from a supplier that doesn't have a food-grade certificate? Their price is much better.
turns.agent:
No. Gaskets come into contact with food and may only be bought from a supplier holding a valid food-grade certificate on file in Bahi. Furthermore, a cheaper quotation does not by itself justify buying a food-contact part from them.

Source: Purchase Policy §6.2; Purchase Policy §6.4

decisions.name: intent
decisions.reason: The user is inquiring about compliance rules regarding purchasing from a supplier without food-grade certification rather than placing an order.

turns.user: Can I place a direct order for ₹80,000 of cartons without raising a purchase request first?
turns.agent:
No. A direct purchase order without a request is allowed only when its gross value, including GST, is ₹50,000 or less.

Source: Purchase Policy §3.3; Purchase Policy §3.1

decisions.name: intent
decisions.reason: The user is asking about the purchasing rules regarding placing a direct order without a prior purchase request rather than instructing to place an order.

turns.user: Can I still charge new orders to cost centre PRD-05?
turns.agent:
Yes, if PRD-05 is an open cost centre, because every request and order must be charged to an open cost centre. A closed cost centre cannot carry new spend and will save the order as a Draft that is never sent. You should check its status on screen FIN-CC-01 or ask Finance before raising the order.

Source: Purchase Policy §4.2; Purchase Policy §4.1

results.name: Policy: does PR approval cover the PO

turns.user: If Rohit approves my purchase request, does that also cover the purchase order raised against it?
turns.agent:
Yes. Approval of a purchase request covers the purchase order raised against it, provided the approver's limit covers the order's gross value.

Source: Purchase Policy §5.4; Purchase Policy §3.4
